+from mkdocs.config import base
+from mkdocs.config import config_options as c
+
+
+class Root:
+    root = c.Type(str, default='root')
+    common = c.Type(int, default=1)
+
+
+class Left(Root):
+    left = c.Type(str, default='left')
+
+
+class Right(Root):
+    right = c.Type(str, default='right')
+    common = c.Type(int, default=2)
+
+
+class Leaf(Left, Right):
+    root = c.Type(str, default='leaf')
+    final = c.Type(bool, default=True)
+
+
+def test_plain_schema_uses_reverse_mro_and_preserves_positions():
+    schema = dict(base.get_schema(Leaf))
+    assert list(schema) == ['root', 'common', 'right', 'left', 'final']
+    assert schema['root'] is Leaf.root
+    assert schema['common'] is Right.common
+    assert schema['right'] is Right.right
+    assert schema['left'] is Left.left
+    assert schema['final'] is Leaf.final
+    assert base.get_schema(Leaf) is base.get_schema(Leaf)
+
+
+def test_non_options_shadow_inherited_options():
+    class Shadow(Leaf):
+        common = 'not an option'
+        right = None
+
+    assert [name for name, _ in base.get_schema(Shadow)] == ['root', 'left', 'final']
+
+
+def test_config_subclass_retains_schema_behavior():
+    class Parent(base.Config):
+        first = c.Type(str, default='first')
+        second = c.Type(int, default=2)
+
+    class Child(Parent):
+        first = c.Type(str, default='override')
+        third = c.Type(bool, default=True)
+
+    schema = dict(base.get_schema(Child))
+    assert list(schema) == ['first', 'second', 'third']
+    config = Child()
+    assert config.first == 'override'
+    assert config.second == 2
+    assert config.third is True

For classes that are not Config subclasses, process each class's own attributes in declaration order, traversing the reversed Python MRO and excluding object. A later non-option attribute of the same name removes that inherited option; reintroducing it afterward gives it a new insertion position.
